notes.title: Small Update: Tweaks, Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
[u]Visual Enhancements:[/u]
•Redesigned the Main Character (MC) with a fresh new outfit.
•Added new animations for the MC.

[u]Updated Level Design:[/u]

•Introduced a new room in the Lava Area.

[u]New Dialogues:[/u]
•Added new dialogue for Little Homunculus in the Lobby.
•Added new dialogue sprites for Little Homunculus and Nihil.
•Audio Adjustments: Tweaked volume levels so that music can be heard clearly without headphones.

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]
•Fixed an issue preventing the player from interacting with Nihil at the Tower Bell entrance.
•Fixed a bug where the MC would attack twice instead of once when pressing the attack button.
•Fixed some floating geometry issues.

[u]Physics Enhancements:[/u]
•Added physics to Little Homunculus and the MC’s clothing.


[u][b]
Developer's Note:[/b][/u]

I apologize for the lack of communication. I've been hard at work creating new monsters and bosses over the past few months. Additionally, I’ve started working on Level 4, which will be revealed in an upcoming trailer. Please look forward to it!

As a bonus, I’ve included the concept art for the MC’s new design at the end of these patch notes. Hope you like it!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002922/aeba71cd5aaf2081bd213a923e954b10648d8b91.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Update with tweaks/Bug fixes/Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]


• Extended the Lava Area by adding a new room to interact with the lever.
• Removed the encounter with Strength, the Tyrant, in the Lava Area.
• Relocated Nihil and the trigger to start her challenge.
• Fixed geometry issues with the teleport ability from the main character in Nihil's challenge room.
• Fixed culling issues in the Bell Area.
• Fixed a bug allowing interaction with Nihil while fighting monsters in her challenge area.
• Fixed an issue where Nihil's portal to her Challenge Area wouldn't load properly, forcing a reload of the area.
• Added visual effects when Little Homunculus reappears after falling into the void.
• Fixed a bug that caused respawning at the first level instead of the Lobby when dying in Nihil's challenge area.
• Added an additional dialogue for Nihil.
• Implemented a new script to automatically sync mouse and controller sensitivity values, avoiding the need to manually adjust parameters.
• Fixed a layer issue that allowed clipping inside some geometry.
• Fixed a bug allowing the player to bypass smoke using the main character's teleport ability when entering Little Homunculus's area.
• Updated tutorial tips to reflect new keyboard assignments for special skills.
• Fixed a bug causing Nihil to move towards a location instead of teleporting there.
• Added missing colliders in the boss area.
• Attempted to fix the issue where the player spawned in a bad location during the Little Homunculus fight.
• Increased the background music volume and fixed the issue where the BGM wouldn't start in Nihil's challenge area.
• Added a portal for faster navigation in the Lava Area after discovering certain secrets.
• Fixed the issue where the same key was used for both skill activation and interaction on keyboards.
• Updated the keyboard/mouse assignment for skills to the 1/2/3 keys, and changed the heal key from 1 to Q.

notes.title: Nihil Update
notes.content:
[h3]Nihil & New Challenge Room Added[/h3]

We're excited to share our latest update, featuring new content for those progressing through the game. You can now interact with Nihil, a character who adds more depth to the story and expands on the game’s lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002922/7d0483d80262141c2ec41f254e6f983c4378aa27.png[/img]

Additionally, a new Challenge Room—crafted by Nihil—is now available for players who have defeated Little Homunculus. This room includes an exclusive enemy that hasn't appeared elsewhere, offering a fresh challenge for even the most skilled players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002922/127b4828ba955b653c0dddf35600ac5c5f19166f.png[/img]

Thanks for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Announcement: New Discord Server & Future Plans!
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/uPqnEzv4XD][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002922/a19f2c2fb037152ce6795273b8c06456a8f1b0c4.png[/img][/url]

Hi everyone,

As promised, we’ve finally made a Discord server where you can directly communicate with us! We’d be glad to have you as part of this newborn community so you can share more feedback and suggestions about the game.


Our new Discord server is now live! Here’s what you can expect:

Direct Communication: Chat with the development team and other players.

Exclusive Announcements: Be the first to know about new updates and features.

Community Events: Participate in special events and contests.

Support & Help: Get assistance and tips from our team and fellow adventurers.

[h3]Demo Update: Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/h3]

We’ve updated the demo to fix several bugs and improve some gameplay elements. Here’s what we’ve worked on:

Bug Fixes: Numerous bugs have been addressed based on the feedback we received, improving overall stability.

Gameplay Enhancements: We’ve improved various aspects of gameplay, notably defense and counter-attack mechanics, which were not working as intended and were too weak.


We plan to continue working on the demo to refine the current systems. Please feel free to try it out whenever you can and share your feedback to help us improve the game.

Thank you for your ongoing support and valuable feedback!
